title: Update homepage tagline to Sanskrit phrase

requirements.summary: Replace the English tagline with Sanskrit phrase 'धर्मो रक्षति रक्षितः' in the Hero component
acceptanceCriteria: The Hero component displays 'धर्मो रक्षति रक्षितः' as the tagline
The Sanskrit text is properly encoded and displays correctly in all browsers
The tagline styling and positioning remain consistent with the existing design

file_operations.description: Replace the tagline text 'Guardians of Eternal Truth • Protectors of Sacred Heritage' with 'धर्मो रक्षति रक्षितः'. Ensure UTF-8 encoding is preserved and the Sanskrit text displays correctly across all browsers. Maintain all existing styling, spacing, and layout properties of the tagline element.
